name: fix-shortcuts-not-triggering-custom-ui
description: Badges render correctly on musictheory.net/lessons/10 but pressing the assigned key (e.g. the Next/Prev lesson nav controls) does nothing. Root cause: activate() called el.click() alone, which only dispatches a `click` event; musictheory's custom lesson controls listen for mousedown/mouseup, so a bare .click() is ignored. DONE: activate() now calls clickEl() which synthesizes a real mouse press (mousedown -> mouseup -> el.click()) at the element's center. Ends with el.click() (not a dispatched MouseEvent) so <a href> navigation and other default actions still fire. Verified headless on musictheory.net/lessons/10: key `l` (Next) advances the lesson step-by-step, key `z` (Prev) goes back. Coordinated mouse events so no double-activation beyond a real click. Affected file: content.js (activate / new clickEl).

name: fix-badge-positioning-for-fixed-elements
description: Badge positioning is wrong for position:fixed elements. ... REFRAMED to occlusion (the real user report: 'badges shown but element not visible'). DONE (6f9295c, PR #5): positionBadges now hides a badge when the element is occluded at its center via elementsFromPoint (a different element is on top — fixed header, modal, content over a TOC). Re-evaluated on scroll/resize via rAF-throttled schedulePositionBadges. Keys stay assigned; only badge display suppressed. Verified headless on ykumar: 8 occluded live badges -> 0. Original fixed/sticky drift never reproduced. Minor follow-up: partially-covered (non-descendant above) is treated as occluded — conservative; refine if it over-hides.

name: skip-non-visible-interactive-elements
description: Badges/shortcuts are being assigned to elements that are not actually visible to the user (e.g. off-screen, display:none ancestors, opacity:0, zero-size, or hidden behind overlays). Add a robust visibility check so only genuinely visible interactive elements receive keys and badges. Affected file: content.js (getInteractiveElements / renderBadges). DONE (7529505): skip display:none/visibility:hidden/opacity:0 + zero-size; MutationObserver watches visibility-affecting attributes. Verified on musictheory (41 hidden-keyed -> 0). Minor follow-up: skip negligible-area elements (e.g. <2px tall) so a badge doesn't land on a 1px separator div.

name: loop-key-pool-when-exhausted
description: When there are more interactive elements than keys in the pool (36: 0-9 + a-z), remaining elements get no shortcut. Extend the assignment so it continues past 36 elements. Affected file: content.js (renderBadges / KEY_POOL usage). PARTIAL (6150b4d): Shift+key second tier extends coverage 36 -> 72 (badge ⇧<key>), matched by e.code + Shift state. Cap 72; full coverage for denser pages needs a sequence scheme (deferred; needs to reconcile with the per-site custom pool).
